name: Sekizaki Tomika
source:
A main commander from the 3rd Unit who is mainly in charge of daily routines. Although she is not a User who is rarely on the frontline, her combat ability is comparable to any other Users.
On her waist, she carries a family [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ōdachi]ōdachi[/url] called "Kunitsugami." The sword has some kind of a history behind it, but she does not really know herself.
